Data management This assignment is intended to demonstrate that I am capable of managing data in data-heavy projects. As an example, the daur2_rna_seq_opdracht directory is used, which is part of the DAUR2 course. It is an RNA sequencing assignment that included many different components and required careful data management and documentation in a README file.
